# 05_Index

## Purpose

Stores tag assignments, workflow index, and validation reports.

## Subdirectories

| Directory | Content | Generated By |
|-----------|---------|--------------|
| `tags/` | Per-paper tag YAML files | `retag.py` / Tag Engine |

## Auto-Generated Content

- `tags/*.yaml` — assigned tags per paper
- `workflow_index_update.json` — workflow index snapshot
- `retrieval_validation_report.md` — search test results

## User Editing

**No** — all content is auto-generated.
